items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Morgan Stanley: US-China Summit Likely to Reinforce Managed Competition

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Morgan Stanley: US-China Summit Likely to Reinforce Managed Competition
evidence.snippet: The September 24 Trump-Xi summit is expected to reinforce the current framework of managed strategic competition rather than produce a major breakthrough. The May meeting delivered sector-specific commercial agreements, new trade and investment dialogue mechanisms, and a commitment to continued engagement, but did not resolve the larger structural disputes. The more useful framework remains stabilisation rather than normalisation. The main focus will be whether that stabilisation can hold into November, when several temporary measures expire at the same time, including Section 301 exclusions, the BIS Affiliates Rule suspension and China’s Wave 2 rare earth controls. China’s separate export licensing regime on seven heavy rare earth elements remains in force, with US imports of yttrium already sharply lower. The summit should therefore offer clues on whether re-escalation risk is building or whether both sides intend to maintain the current path.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Deutsche Bank: Warsh’s Jackson Hole Speech Comes Against a Difficult Policy Backdrop

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Deutsche Bank: Warsh’s Jackson Hole Speech Comes Against a Difficult Policy Backdrop
evidence.snippet: Kevin Warsh will deliver the Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, with his remarks likely to take one of two forms: a broader “big-picture” speech or a more traditional setup for the September-to-December policy meetings. The backdrop is challenging, with inflation still elevated, active debate over whether tighter policy is needed, and three dissents in favour of a hike at the July FOMC meeting. Warsh’s July press conference also raised questions about how willing the Committee is to tighten if inflation stays persistent, contributing to higher long-term inflation expectations and bond yields. If he chooses the broader approach, one likely topic is the Fed’s new task forces, where many details remain unclear around scope, interaction with the FOMC, timelines, and how recommendations could translate into changes to the Fed’s framework or operations.

items.original_title: 뉴욕 타임스에 따르면, 미국은 이란 전쟁 중에 철수한 중동 지역 대사관에 외교관을 다시 파견할 준비를 하고 있으며, 일부 대사관은 이번 주에 인력을 늘려 정상 운영을 재개할 수 있습니다. 이번에 계획된 인력 증원은 이스라엘, 레바논, 요르단, 오만, 사우디아라비아, 카타르, 이라크, 쿠웨이트에 영향을 미칠 예정이지만, 일부 지역은 여전히 정원 규모에 미치지 못할 것입니다.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole: Europe’s Energy Crisis Is Worsening

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Credit Agricole: Europe’s Energy Crisis Is Worsening
evidence.snippet: Despite a pullback in crude prices, Europe’s broader energy backdrop is deteriorating. Natural gas prices are approaching €70/MWh, above Q2 levels, while 2027 electricity prices continue to rise. Combined with very high gasoline and diesel crack spreads, the pressure is broader than crude alone suggests. The concern is that these energy costs could feed into food and core inflation, particularly in the first half of 2027. Headline HICP is now seen running around 3.5%-4.0% year-on-year through the end of Q1 2027, while core inflation is expected to gradually rise toward 3.0% by March 2027.
